acceptanceCriteria: A new CEM profile version represents empty create/delete and mode-only changes with metadata identity and binding; cem/1.0 bytes and its refusal are unchanged; native and portable conformance pass.
body: Deferred from V1-0609 by decision 0546 §4. In 1.0 these diffs are refused with a typed code. After 1.0, define a versioned metadata identity and binding with explicit uncertainty in a new profile version, without changing the frozen cem/1.0 bytes.
title: Represent metadata-only diffs (empty create/delete, mode-only) in a post-1.0 CEM profile
